method: Piecewise annual history using pre-1955 Slovenian tennis/federation tradition plus post-independence federation continuity, current registered scale, professional-tournament pathway and coach-development evidence.
evidence_rules: Pre-independence Slovenian tennis history supports tradition/context without pretending Slovenia was an independent state before 1991.
Current member, competitor and club counts are not backcast.
Professional-event hosting informs competition opportunity/pathway capacity, not participation.
Tutor programme evidence informs development quality, not measured player outcomes.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
